methods: Formalize a missing boundary lemma identified by the selected review.

original_card.acceptance_gate: State the exact formalized proposition and remaining assumptions; avoid duplicate arithmetic formalizations already present.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one missing statement with quantified hypotheses, actual caller and existing coverage. A compact-switch lemma is a candidate only after its mathematical contract is reviewed. Establish a bounded proof plan before a separately budgeted proof-assistant build; do not rerun large Lean jobs as orientation.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A missing interface proof can reduce the conditional gap even if it does not change kappa.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one formal lemma or one theorem-to-certificate binding.
scope_change_triggers: Formalizing already-covered arithmetic and claiming the full multiplication theorem.

existing_checks.remaining: Exact theorem-to-caller binding and genuinely uncovered interface lemmas.
Uniform algorithmic implications, not another endpoint digit.

existing_checks.scope: PR #4100: compact-switch formalization proposed as future validation.
existing_checks.remaining: Audit the statement and assumptions before a formal proof campaign.

actual_scope: Sharp positive-width equivalence horizon max(1,D-r-b+2), with positive seed rank r and right-boundary rank b, and attaining examples for every admissible triple over every field.
scope_change_reason: An independently posed rank-nullity refinement of the fixed physical transfer-table interface replaces a selected-caller formalization. This is a written exact-interface proof with bounded corroboration, not a Lean proof or predecessor audit.
bottleneck_link: A smaller exact finite horizon can reduce the largest physical width needed to reject or certify a supplied complete transfer representation. Actual table extraction and physical supplier admission remain separate.
stop_rule: Discovery stops at the first proved horizon refinement and its sharpness family; no further mathematical extension.
evidence: Written all-field proof; 137896 normalized binary contracts, 288662 literal endpoint-block observations, 650 sharp rank-triple fixtures, nine invalid-domain rejections and five semantic controls.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Can one actual complete provider/consumer residual exhibit b>1 and a useful horizon reduction after all returns are included?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The abstract rank saving does not supply an extracted physical table or reduce its representation size.
open_questions.first_step: Extract one complete residual and compute its positive seed rank and exact right-boundary rank, then compare the two horizons.
open_questions.blocked_by: Actual source-table extraction and its complete native, ownership and physical costs are outside this package.

freshness.coverage: Live open PR bodies, account recent PRs, active Discussions, recent handoffs, main README formula/object searches and merged/all-state searches. Arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work are unknown.
